name: Nagyvázsony (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of medium blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagyvázsony (a blue shield with a crescent, a star and an arm holding a sabre) below the name NAGYVÁZSONY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
